main_body: Steampunk lamp post: a domed grey cap on top, a glowing lantern block, a thin pole with a collar, and a domed base at the bottom
top_band: At x=8, rows 1-4 are light grey (L≈148-158). The dome is wider than the pole and has rounded corners. Below it, rows 5-7 are mid grey (L=122), then rows 8-10 are darker (L=95 to 53).
evidence: The top cap is a rounded dome wider than the shaft. It has 4 lighter rows (L≈148-158) over a mid-grey body (L=122), a step of about 26 L, and darker rows (95, 53) under it that act as the eave shadow. The base repeats this with a light top (L=158 at x=8, rows 36-39 at x=4) over darker side rows. The lantern shows dark inset frames around its glass. There is no distinct front-edge line, and the top is only borderline in height and contrast. It passes as an ellipse cap, but narrowly.

style.evidence: The grey metal has about 5-6 lightness steps, but the surfaces are smooth and carry little grain or per-part highlight. The thin pole is flat. The candidate uses only 13 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references, and 13 colours per tile against 17-20. 45% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline reads as a partly near-black sticker line next to the tinted outlines of the stall reference. Flat-fill coverage (13%) matches the stall. Overall it is thinner and flatter than the Beodeul pieces.
